claim: No tattoos: anyone with ink can't go in.
fix: Tattoos: Japanese or Japan-resident men are refused outright, but male tourists can enter with a passport and a ¥330 tattoo sticker over one tattoo, and women's fashion tattoos are allowed (a sticker is only needed above 30 cm x 30 cm).

claim: The weekend rate is higher, and staying between 1:00 and 6:00 costs extra.
fix: The weekend rate is higher, and anyone in the building between midnight and 6:00 pays a late-night surcharge (Fri-Sun roughly +¥2,300 general).
Be out before midnight (0:00), when the late-night surcharge starts.

claim: Korakuen Hall is a sweaty 1,800-seat box where every seat is close to the ring.
fix: Korakuen Hall is a sweaty 1,403-seat box where every seat is close to the ring.
source_quote: 南固定席/780席 可動席/東：109席 西：109席 北：405席 合計：1,403席
